name: Fairmont Le Montreux Palace
positioning: Belle Époque hotel on the shore of Lake Geneva in Montreux, established in 1906
best_for: Music fans who want a stay tied to Montreux's jazz heritage
Travelers who want a lake and Alps setting near Chillon Castle

facts.text: The hotel is a Belle Époque hotel established in 1906.
The hotel sits on the shore of Lake Geneva, at the foot of the Alps and near Chillon Castle.
The Fairmont Spa has both indoor and outdoor pools and lake views.
La Terrasse du Petit Palais serves al fresco meals with lake views.
The Montreux Jazz Café has a festival atmosphere.
La Brasserie specializes in Swiss cuisine.
The Montreux Jazz Festival takes place in Montreux in early July.
The hotel gives easy access to Chillon Castle and the Lavaux vineyards.

highlights.text: The Panorama one-bedroom suite is dedicated to either Freddie Mercury or Claude Nobs.
The Quincy Jones one-bedroom suite has two private rooftop terraces with lake and Alpine views.
The hotel was used as a hospital to shelter Allied soldiers during both World Wars.
Yellow canopies over the rooms' balconies give the hotel a distinctive exterior.
Funky Claude's Bar has live concerts and DJ sets.

considerations.text: Parking is available at the hotel for an additional fee.
Geneva Airport is about one hour from the hotel by train or car.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing that may not suit budget-conscious travelers.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Fairmont Le Montreux Palace
